metadata.title: Satyendra Nath Bose — a Bear's Notes mini-bio
metadata.style: white on near-black, grey secondary, no accent colour, Montserrat. Each beat's on-screen time = its narration length.
metadata.structure: Bear narrates throughout; visuals alternate render:clip footage (soul-id / phenomenon / application) and render:manim cards (title / equation / date).
metadata.facts: S. N. Bose 1894-1974. 1924 paper rederived Planck's law from quantum statistics; sent to Einstein, who translated + published it. Bosons named for him (Dirac). Bose-Einstein condensate predicted with Einstein (1924-25), realized 1995. Never won a Nobel.
